I also play piano, flute, bass, and conga. Flute was my first instrument, followed by guitar. I set the flute down for 30 years, only recently picking it back up. I spent most of that time focusing on guitar, so I'd say that guitar is my primary. I played piano for a year back in HS, but never was very serious about it, but started taking lessons again over a year ago and am really putting the effort in. I practice piano about an hour a day, and I don't allow myself to touch another instrument until the piano practice is done. I picked up the bass a few years ago out of necessity to get some recording done, and found that I really enjoy playing bass in a studio setting, but probably wouldn't want to do it live. Percussion was also a necessity of recording.
